description: Source file implementing system property retrieval functions for UWP devices on Windows, including device info, version, and device type.

classes.name: UwpDevice
classes.description: Structure representing device form, chipset model, model, and year for known UWP devices.

classes.name: WindowsVersion
classes.description: Structure holding Windows version components: major, minor, build, revision.

methods.name: CopyStringAndTestIfSuccess
methods.description: Copies a string or wide string to output buffer, testing for success based on buffer size.

methods.name: GetWindowsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves Windows version info and fills a WindowsVersion struct.

methods.name: GetDeviceForm
methods.description: Returns device form string from AnalyticsInfo.

methods.name: GetChipsetModelNumber
methods.description: Returns chipset model based on device form, or unknown if not recognized.

methods.name: GetFirmwareVersion
methods.description: Gets firmware version string based on Windows version info.

methods.name: GetModelYear
methods.description: Returns device model year based on device form.

methods.name: GetModelName
methods.description: Returns device model name based on device form.

methods.name: GetPlatformName
methods.description: Constructs platform name string with OS and version.
